app.name: ACACIA
app.tagline: Leave a little space in your day

today.title: Today
today.bannerTitle: Take your time. It will all work out.
today.bannerText: A few things that matter, and plenty of room to breathe.
today.timelineEmpty: Nothing planned yet. Tap to add +
today.quickPlaceholder: Type a task and press Enter…
today.timelineEmptyOther: Nothing planned for this day. Tap to add +
today.lowStock: {{count}} items running low, plan a restock

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.addOnDay: + Add an event on this day

shopping.readOnlyHint: This entry is synced from Shopping & Ledger and is view-only in the calendar. Change its time, amount or name, or delete it, in the shopping list and the calendar updates automatically.
shopping.archivedHint: This entry is in the yearly ledger and is view-only in the calendar. To change it, restore it to the list from the ledger first.

places.title: Favorite places
places.filterPlaceholder: Search by name, address or note…
places.empty: No saved places in this category

form.search: Search for a place (pick a result to fill in details)

form.filled: Filled in hours and details for “{{cat}}”
form.name: Name

note.clinicTip: Reminder: bring your health insurance card and check clinic hours first.

sort.label: Sort
sort.reorderHint: Drag the handle on the left, or use the up and down buttons. With a keyboard, use the arrow keys. The order saves automatically and is included in backups and sync.
sort.needLocation: Sorting by distance needs your current location. It is only used on this device to calculate distances and is never uploaded or saved. Until then, places stay in your order.
sort.locating: Getting your current location… (showing your order for now)
sort.located: Sorted from nearest to farthest (your location is used only on this device and is never uploaded or saved).
sort.noCoords: Places without coordinates: {{count}}. They are listed last; paste coordinates or a Google Maps link when editing a place.
sort.openHint: Uses this device’s current time to read today’s hours from each place’s “Hours & closed days”. Places with no hours, or hours that can’t be read, are listed last as unknown. Temporary closures and holidays are not reflected.

error.denied: Location permission is off, so places can’t be sorted by distance. Showing your order instead. Allow location in your browser or system settings, then try again.
error.unavailable: Couldn’t get your current location. Showing your order instead.
error.timeout: Getting your location timed out. Showing your order instead.
error.unsupported: This browser doesn’t support location, so places can’t be sorted by distance. Showing your order instead.
error.consent: Location can be used after you accept the privacy policy. Showing your order instead.

lowStock.title: Running low, plan a restock
lowStock.hint: Items below their safety stock show up here automatically. Check them off on the shopping list and the quantity is added to stock; they disappear once back at safety stock.

shopping.title: Shopping & budget

form.title: Item
form.amtHint: Amount is optional, so it works as a plain shopping list too. Each item can use its own currency; currencies are subtotaled separately.

archive.nothing: Nothing to archive in this period yet
archive.confirmText: This moves {{count}} entries from this period ({{start}} – {{end}}) into the {{year}} ledger and starts the list fresh. You can restore them from the ledger later.

ledger.title: Yearly ledger
ledger.empty: No archived periods yet. Each period is archived automatically after it ends (from the 10th of each month), or tap “Archive this period” to do it now.

shopping.budgetOnly: Budget progress counts {{sym}} spending only; other currencies are listed separately, not converted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataHelp: Import a JSON file exported from the old ACACIA, or export your current data as a backup. Importing replaces your current data.
settings.importConfirm: Importing replaces all your current data. Continue?

fontSize.title: Text size
fontSize.help: Make text larger for easier reading. Applies instantly and is remembered.

currency.title: Default currency
currency.help: Expense amounts and the currency label next to amount fields use this currency, and new subscriptions start with it. Only the symbol changes; amounts are not converted, and saved subscriptions keep their own currency.

navOrder.title: Sidebar order
navOrder.help: Change the order of items under “Collect & organize” in the sidebar. Drag the handle on the left, or use the up and down arrows. Your order is saved, backed up and synced.

event.title: What's the plan?
event.notePlaceholder: Place, things to bring, any reminder
event.endBeforeStart: End time must be after start time

search.title: Search
search.placeholder: Search tasks, notes, events or places…
search.hint: Search by task name, note, event or place

sync.title: Cloud sync
sync.signIn: Sign in with Google to sync
sync.signOutConfirm: Sign out of Google? Your data stays on this device.
sync.error: Sync failed. Your data is saved on this device
sync.help: After you sign in, your data is kept in your Google Drive's app-only space, so you see the same data on any device. The first sign-in also loads your backup from the old ACACIA.

reminders.title: Don’t-forget reminders
reminders.empty: No reminders yet. Create one to be reminded of your essentials when you leave work or arrive home.
reminders.settingsHelp: Get reminded to check your wallet, keys and other essentials when you arrive at or leave a place.

status.idle: Location isn’t being watched (needs at least one enabled reminder with coordinates)
status.watching: Watching your location. You’ll be reminded when you cross a set area
status.denied: Location permission was denied. Allow it from your browser’s address bar
status.unsupported: This browser can’t get your location
status.error: Can’t get your location right now. Still trying
status.webNote: The web version needs this page to stay open to detect your location. The upcoming iOS app will use background geofencing.

notify.default: System notifications are off, so reminders only show on the page
notify.denied: System notifications are blocked by the browser, so reminders only show on the page
notify.unsupported: This browser doesn’t support system notifications, so reminders only show on the page

card.noCoords: No coordinates yet, so this can’t be detected. Edit it and use your current location or paste coordinates.

form.coords: Coordinates (paste from a map or a map link)
form.coordsMissing: No coordinates yet. Use your current location, or paste “latitude, longitude” or a map link, so it can be detected.
form.coordsInvalid: Can’t read those coordinates. Paste “latitude, longitude” or a map link that contains them.
form.geoDenied: Can’t get your location: permission was denied.
form.geoFail: Can’t get your location. Please try again.
form.timeHint: Time window is optional. If left empty, it applies all day

licenses.loadFail: Couldn't load the license list. Please try again later.
licenses.summary: {{total}} packages: {{runtime}} ship with the site, {{dev}} are used only for development and builds.
licenses.noStrong: No packages use strong copyleft licenses such as GPL or AGPL, so none of them require publishing this project's source code.
licenses.strongWarn: {{count}} packages use strong copyleft licenses such as GPL or AGPL and may require publishing source code when distributed: {{names}}

licenses.weakNote: Weak copyleft (such as MPL): only changes to that package's own files would have to be published; this project's code is not affected. {{names}}
licenses.unknownWarn: Couldn't identify the license of {{count}} packages. Please check them manually: {{names}}

licenses.noText: This package ships no license text. Please check its source repository.

currency.label: Currency
currency.customHelp: Up to 8 characters. A 3-letter uppercase code (e.g. THB) uses that currency’s formatting.

recurring.importHint: Pick what to add and adjust amounts or notes first. Starting this period ({{start}} – {{end}}), each item adds as many months as it's set to; months already added are skipped.
recurring.empty: No fixed costs yet. Set up what you pay every period (phone bill, installments, loans, insurance…) and add them all in one tap each period.
recurring.allAdded: All fixed costs are already in this period. You can add them again next period.

form.name: Name
form.dayHint: Day 1–31. Days 1–9 fall in the period's second month; if a month is shorter, the last day is used.
form.installmentHint: Adding starts from the next payment; adding several months moves the count forward. After the last payment it's marked done.
form.batchMonths: Months to add at a time
form.batchHint: When adding fixed costs, create this many months in a row starting this period (1–{{max}}). Months already added are skipped.
form.batchInvalid: Months must be a whole number from 1 to {{max}}
form.totalInvalid: Total payments must be a whole number of at least 1
form.paidInvalid: Paid payments must be between 0 and the total
form.paidOffHint: Fully paid. It will be marked done when saved

recurring.completed: “{{name}}” reached its final payment and is marked done.

backup.title: Automatic backup
backup.help: When you open the app or change data, and the last backup is over 12 hours old, a backup runs in the background. The latest {{count}} snapshots are kept. While signed in to Google, it is also saved to the backup slot in your Drive.

cloud.label: Google Drive backup slot
cloud.signedOut: Not signed in — saved on this device only
cloud.error: Upload failed — snapshots on this device are safe

backup.offNote: Automatic backup is off. You can still back up manually.
backup.unchanged: Your data matches the latest backup, so no new backup is needed
backup.fail: Something went wrong. Your data was not changed
backup.restoreConfirm:
Restore your data to the backup from {{time}}?
Your current data will first be saved as a “Before restore” snapshot, so you can go back.

deleteData.title: Delete all data
deleteData.help: Erases all data, automatic backups and preferences on this device. This cannot be undone, so consider using “Export JSON” first.
deleteData.cloudOn: You are signed in to Google: ACACIA’s sync and backup files in your Google Drive app folder (including the old website’s sync file) will also be deleted, and you will be signed out.
deleteData.cloudOff: You are not signed in, so only data on this device will be deleted. To delete cloud data too, sign in with Google above first.
deleteData.confirmLocal: Delete all ACACIA data and automatic backups on this device? This cannot be undone.
deleteData.confirmCloud:
Delete all ACACIA data?
This deletes data and automatic backups on this device, plus ACACIA’s sync and backup files in your Google Drive, and signs you out. This cannot be undone.
deleteData.done: All data on this device has been deleted
deleteData.doneCloud: All ACACIA data on this device and in Google Drive has been deleted, and you have been signed out
deleteData.fail: Delete failed and your data was not changed. Check your connection and try again.

title.first: Please read and agree before you start
title.updated: Our documents have been updated. Please read and agree again

intro.first: Welcome to ACACIA. Before you start, please read the Privacy Policy and the Third-party licenses below. By tapping “Agree and start”, you confirm that you have read and agree to them.
intro.updated: Since you last agreed, we have updated: {{docs}}. Please read again and agree to keep using ACACIA. Your data is not affected.

consent.versions: Privacy Policy version {{privacy}} · Third-party licenses version {{licenses}}.
consent.note: Your agreement is saved only in this browser on this device. You will be asked again if you clear browser data or switch devices.

declined.title: You need to agree to use ACACIA
declined.body: If you don't agree, you can't use ACACIA. Until you agree, ACACIA will not start Google sign-in, location, automatic backups or cloud sync.
declined.leave: If you don't want to use it, just close this tab. If you change your mind, tap “Agree and start” below.

sortable.keyboardHelp: Press the up and down arrow keys to move this item.

holidays.title: Import public holidays
holidays.intro: Pick a country and years to add its public holidays to your calendar. Holiday data is built into the app, so importing never connects to another service or uses your location. The default country is only guessed from your browser's time zone and language.
holidays.loadError: Couldn't load holiday data. Please reload the page and try again.
holidays.nationalOnly: Only nationwide holidays are included; state and provincial holidays are not.

source.official: Source: {{source}}. Based on official announcements, including substitute holidays and make-up workdays. Only announced years are available.
source.rules: Source: {{source}}. Calculated from each country's statutory rules, so it may differ from ad-hoc government announcements (such as election days or holidays set by the moon). Please check official announcements.

sourceName.TW: Taiwan DGPA government office calendar (Government Open Data Platform)
sourceName.CN: China State Council holiday notices (compiled by holiday-cn)
sourceName.KR: Korea AeroSpace Administration almanac (compiled by holidays-kr)

rhythm.title: Adjust today's rhythm
rhythm.intro: Set when you usually wake up and go to bed. Your rhythm and free time on the Today page are counted within these hours.
rhythm.same: Wake and bedtime can't be the same

sharing.searchPreviewHint: Previewing another member: only the shared events they can see are searched. Your tasks, expenses, places and other personal data are not shown.

sync.title: Cloud sync for shared spaces
sync.help: When on, shared spaces sync to the app-specific folder of your own Google Drive (acacia_spaces_v1.json). It contains only the events you created and what you are allowed to see.
sync.off: Off. Shared spaces are stored on this device only
sync.needSignIn: Sign in with Google above first
sync.stopTitle: Turn off cloud sync for shared spaces

sync.stopKeep: Just stop syncing (keep the file in Drive)
sync.stopDelete: Stop syncing and delete the file in Drive…
sync.deleteConfirm: Delete acacia_spaces_v1.json from your Google Drive? Other devices will no longer get shared spaces from the cloud. This cannot be undone (data on this device is kept).
sync.stopped: Sync stopped. The file in Drive was kept
sync.deleted: Sync stopped and the file in Drive was deleted
sync.stopFailed: Couldn’t turn it off. Please try again later

backup.title: Shared space snapshots
backup.help: A snapshot is kept on this device every 12 hours when something changed (up to 7), separate from the main backups. Restoring also syncs to your other devices.
backup.same: Nothing changed since the latest snapshot
backup.restoreConfirm: Restore shared spaces to the snapshot from {{time}}? A snapshot of the current data is taken first.
